comments.author: @AjinkyaShinde-v5j
comments.text: Mark, we went to Athens for a few days last week and visited this Diporto restaurant BECAUSE YOU RECOMMENDED IT. However we were quite disappointed with the food. Amount paid for 2 people was 50 Euro (in Cash, no cards accepted), which we found too much for the pretty tasteless food. We had the initial fava puree with a bread, a chickpea dish with some gravy (cant call it a curry at all) which was completely tasteless. We saw someone having a dish of cannellini beans so we asked for one and that one at least had some flavour but nothing to write home about. The sardines dish was also pretty tasteless and only the skin which was barbecued had at least some taste. The wine was served not in the copper mug but in a orange coloured dirty plastic mug. I decided to write a comment here because I dont want other people watching this video to get carried away and unnecessarily carry great expectations the way we did.
